rules.interpretation_hi_en: Paramparik manyata ke anusaar chaudi aur gehri santaan rekha putra ka sanket maani jaati hai. Yeh keval Samudrik parampara ki vyakhya hai — kisi bhi garbh ya bhavishya ki santaan ke liye koi bhavishyavani nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.IX — broad and deep lines denote male children

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Paramparik manyata ke anusaar patli aur mahin santaan rekha kanya ka sanket maani jaati hai. Yeh keval Samudrik parampara ki vyakhya hai — kisi bhi garbh ya bhavishya ki santaan ke liye koi bhavishyavani nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.IX — fine and narrow lines denote female children

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Santaan rekhayein seedhi aur spasht hain — parampara mein yeh swasth, majboot santaan ka shubh sanket maana jaata hai.

sources.loc: Ch.IX — straight lines denote strong healthy children

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Santaan rekhayein dheemi ya tedhi hain — parampara mein ise bachchon ke swasthya par vishesh dhyan dene ka sanket maana jaata hai. Iska matlab hai care aur poshan par thoda extra focus — koi medical nishkarsh nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.IX — faint or crooked lines indicate delicate children; softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Santaan rekha ki shuruaat mein chhota island hai par aage rekha saaf ho jaati hai — parampara mein iska arth: bachpan mein sehat nazuk, par badhne ke saath majboot aur swasth. Shuruaati varshon mein extra care, aage sab theek.

sources.loc: Ch.IX — island at start then well-marked line: delicate early life, grows up strong; terminal-island clause excluded per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Santaan rekhaon mein ek rekha baaki sab se zyada spasht aur gehri hai — parampara kehti hai ki yeh santaan maata-pita ke sabse kareeb hogi aur sabse zyada safal bhi. Ghar ka sitara.

sources.loc: Ch.IX — one line clear and distinct among others: that child closer to parent and more successful

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha jeevan rekha se uthti hai — self-made kahani. Shuruati saal tang aur pariwar/paristhitiyon se bandhe rahe, lekin rekha jahan se saaf hoti hai, wahan se safalta apni mehnat aur merit se aati hai — kismat se nahi. Jis umra par rekha jeevan rekha se alag hoti hai, wahi aapki azaadi ka saal hai.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XI position 2, p.50

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha kalai se seedhi Shani parvat tak jaati hai aur saath mein Surya rekha bhi hai — bhagyashali destiny ka sabse sundar combination. Kismat, chamak aur safalta teeno aapke path par hain.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XI positions 1 & 4, p.50

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha Chandra parvat se uthti hai — aapki unnati doosron ke sahyog, pasand aur samarthan se judi hai. Jeevan-saathi, sasural paksh, public ya prabhavshali log — aapki taraqqi mein doosron ka haath spashth rahega. Rishton mein invest karna aapke liye career-strategy hai.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XI position 3, p.51

sources.loc: bhagya rekha

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Chandra parvat se uthti bhagya rekha hriday rekha se jud jaati hai — sukhad aur samriddh vivah ka prachin sanket. Prem, romance aur saubhagya ka aisa sangam jisme jeevan-saathi ki pasand aur sahyog aapki kismat ko nayi disha dega.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XII position 1, pp.51-52

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Ek prabhav-rekha (influence line) bhagya rekha se aakar mil jaati hai — jis samay yeh milan hota hai, us samay kisi khaas vyakti ka aapke jeevan mein pravesh, aksar vivah ya sthayi saath ke roop mein. Yeh rekha jitni saaf, milan utna hi majboot.

sources.loc: Ch.V Influence Lines, Plate XIII position 3, p.57

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Prabhav-rekha bhagya rekha ke saath-saath chalti hai par milti nahi — koi vyakti aapke jeevan mein gehri jagah rakhta hai, lekin dono ki zindagiyan alag rehti hain. Jab tak rekha saath chalti hai, prabhav rahega; rishton mein clarity rakhna aapke hi haath mein hai.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XII position 2, p.52

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Prabhav-rekha bhagya rekha ko kaat kar Jupiter ki or nikal jaati hai — savdhaan: koi vyakti aapke rishte ko apni mahatvakanksha ki seedhi bana sakta hai. Iska matlab sab par shak karna nahi — bas jo aapko use kare aur value na kare, use samay rehte pehchan lena.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XII position 3, p.52

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha se ek shakha Jupiter parvat ki or — jis umra par yeh shakha nikalti hai, wahan se adhikar, uchch pad aur logon par command ki shuruaat. Agar shakha parvat tak poori pahunchti hai, toh yeh us lakshya ke liye safalta ka sarvashreshth sanket hai.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XI position 6, pp.52-53

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha se shakha Surya parvat ki or — dhan aur public pehchan dono ek saath. Naam bhi, daam bhi. Yeh un logon ka sanket hai jinki safalta chhupti nahi, chamakti hai.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XI position 7, p.53

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha se shakha Budh parvat ki or — vigyan, vyapar ya technology mein koi khaas uplabdhi ka sanket. Aapki safalta ka raasta buddhi aur len-den ki samajh se hokar jaata hai.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XI position 8, pp.53-54

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha hatheli ke beech (Mangal kshetra) se shuru hoti hai — shuruati zindagi sangharsh bhari, har cheez ladkar paani padi. Lekin agar rekha yahan se majboot uthti hai (aur Surya ki or shakha ho), toh aap apni kismat ke khud architect hain — bina kisi sahare ke, sirf mehnat aur merit se.

sources.loc: Ch.V Rising from the Middle of the Palm, p.55

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha mastishk rekha se uthti hai — safalta der se aayegi, lekin poori tarah aapke dimaag ki kamai hogi. Yeh late-bloomer ka nahi, deep-thinker ka sanket hai: jab aayega, bada aayega.

sources.loc: Ch.V, p.55

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha mastishk rekha par jaakar ruk jaati hai — savdhaan: career ka sabse bada khatra bahar se nahi, apne hi kisi galat faisle se hai. Bade decisions par thanda dimaag, doosri raay aur data — yeh teen aapke bodyguard hain.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XII position 4, p.55

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha hriday rekha par ruk jaati hai — dil ke galat jagah lagne se career ko dhakka lagne ka sanket. Pyaar karna galti nahi hai; galat vyakti ke liye apne sapne chhodna galti hai. Rishta wahi sahi jo aapke lakshya ko bada kare, chhota nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.V, p.54

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya aur hriday rekha milkar Jupiter parvat par chadhti hain — prem se prapti ka sarvottam yog. Aapka pyaar aapki ambition ka fuel banega; jeevan-saathi aur apne log aapko oopar uthayenge. Kismat aapke rishton ke raaste aayegi.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XII position 1, pp.54-55

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha tooti hai lekin nayi rekha purani ke khatam hone se PEHLE shuru ho jaati hai — yeh break nahi, upgrade hai. Jagah, kaam ya position ka poora badlav, aur nayi rekha jahan se shuru hoti hai wahan se pragati. Planned transition aapke favour mein hai.

sources.loc: Ch.V, p.57

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Do bhagya rekhayein — do samanantar careers ka yog: ek mukhya kaam, ek passion project (ya do alag duniya ek saath). Agar aage jaakar dono milti hain, toh jo rukavat do raahon ko alag rakhti thi, woh us mod par hat jaayegi.

sources.loc: Ch.V Double Lines of Fate, Plate XIV position 2, pp.57-58

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha halki hai lekin mastishk rekha zabardast — aap kismat ko maanne walon mein se nahi hain, aur aapko zaroorat bhi nahi. Aapki safalta shudh roop se aapke dimaag ki den hogi. Destiny aapke liye likhi nahi gayi; aap use roz likhte hain.

sources.loc: Ch.V, p.58

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya aur mastishk rekha ke sangam par island — us daur mein apni hi soch se hue ek nuksaan (aksar paison ka) ka sanket. Yeh warning system hai, sazaa nahi: us phase mein bade financial faisle double-check karo, akele mat lo.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XIV position 6, p.60

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha par Mangal kshetra mein island — ek daur aisa jisme career mein rukavat aur kharcha aamdani se aage nikal sakta hai. Us window mein reserve fund banaye rakhna aur naye bade daanv taalna hi samajhdari hai.

sources.loc: Ch.V, Plate XIV position 3, pp.59-60

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki tarjani (Jupiter finger) asadharan roop se lambi hai — netritva, mahatvakanksha aur niyam banane ki natural shakti ka sanket. Aap logon ko organize karne aur aage se lead karne ke liye bane hain.

sources.loc: Preface: The Fingers Considered Separately

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Anamika (Sun finger) tarjani se kaafi lambi hai aur Surya rekha bhi maujood hai — paison ke maamle mein risk lene ki prabal ichchha. Calculated risk aapko suit karta hai, lekin impulse decisions se bachna zaroori hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VI Line of Sun, p.64

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Kanishtika (little finger) lambi hai — vaani ki shakti aur shabdon ka jaadu aapka gift hai. Bolne, samjhane aur convince karne ke kaam (sales, teaching, public speaking, content) mein aap naturally chamakte hain.

sources.loc: Preface: The Fingers Considered Separately

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Chhoti kanishtika ka matlab hai bolne se zyada likhne mein aapki taakat hai. Naye logon ke saamne sankoch swabhavik hai — lekin likhit shabd aapke vichaaron ko poori shakti se pahunchate hain.

sources.loc: Preface: The Fingers Considered Separately

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Tarjani aur anamika bilkul barabar — santulit mastishk ka durlabh sanket. Ambition aur creativity aapke andar perfect balance mein hain; na zyada dikhawa, na kam aatmavishwas.

sources.loc: Preface: The Fingers Considered Separately

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Angushtha ka nail-parv lamba aur pat­la hai — shaant, adrishya lekin atoot willpower. Aap bina shor machaye apni baat manwate hain aur gusse par poora niyantran rakhte hain.

sources.loc: Preface: Character Shown by the Thumb

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Angushtha hatheli se sata hua hai — savdhaan aur suraksha-pradhan swabhav. Paise ko sambhal kar rakhna aapki taakat hai, lekin kabhi-kabhi naye avsar par 'haan' kehna seekhna faydemand rahega.

sources.loc: Preface: Character Shown by the Thumb

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Guru ungli (pehli/index) lambi hai — netritva aur command ka chinh: logon ko direction dena, zimmedari uthana, aage khade hona aapko naturally aata hai. Power aapko darati nahi, bulati hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — long Finger of Jupiter: love of power and command

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Guru ungli chhoti hai — bade pad aur zimmedari ka bojh aapko aakarshit nahi karta; aap limelight ke bina, apne kaam mein sukoon se rehna pasand karte ho. Yeh kami nahi hai — duniya ko har jagah boss nahi, bharosemand expert bhi chahiye. Bas itna dekhna ki jo deserve karte ho, uske liye awaaz utha sako.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — short Jupiter finger: dislike of responsibility, lack of ambition (reframed)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Shani ungli (beech wali) lambi hai — soch-samajh (prudence), ekant-priyata aur gambhir, studious swabhav ka chinh. Bheed se zyada aapko apni company pasand hai, aur halke topics se zyada gehre. Depth aapka default mode hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — long Saturn finger: prudence, solitude, reserved studious disposition

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Shani ungli chhoti hai — swabhav mein halkapan: zindagi ko zyada seriously na lene ki pravritti. Fun aapke saath hamesha hai, par jahan gambhirta chahiye (paisa, sehat, commitments) wahan conscious effort lagana padega. Mazaa lo, par zaroori cheezon ka calendar bana lo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — short Saturn finger: frivolity, lack of seriousness

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Surya ungli (teesri/ring) lambi hai — sundarta se prem aur naam-yash ki chah ka chinh. Aap chahte ho ki aapka kaam dikhe, sarahe jaye, yaad rakha jaye — aur yeh bhookh hi aapse best kaam nikalwati hai. Fame-drive ko fuel banao, boss nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — long Sun finger: love of the beautiful, desire for celebrity and fame

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Surya ungli zaroorat se zyada lambi hai — Cheiro ki saaf warning wala variant: yash ki chah notoriety mein, aur paise ki chah SATTEBAZI-JUE ke aakarshan mein badal sakti hai. Risk ka nasha aapke liye real hai. Iska ilaaj sharm nahi, HARD LIMITS hain: speculation ke liye fixed chhota budget (jo doob jaye toh farak na pade), usse ek rupaya upar nahi — aur udhaar lekar daanv kabhi nahi. Limit hi aapki asli jeet hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — excessively long Sun finger: notoriety, risk in speculation, love of gambling; rendered as hard-limits caution per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Surya ungli chhoti hai — naam-yash ke khel mein aapki ruchi kam hai: dikhawa, limelight, social race — yeh sab aapko kheenchta nahi. Aap kaam ke liye kaam karte ho, taaliyon ke liye nahi. Shanti isi mein hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — short Sun finger: dislike of fame/beauty pursuits

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Budh ungli (chhoti/pinky) lambi hai — maansik shakti, bhashaon ki pakad aur EXPRESSION ka chinh, khaaskar bolne mein. Communication aapka natural hathiyar hai: samjhana, manana, bechna, sikhana — sab isi ungli se chalta hai. Speaking-heavy roles mein aapka edge built-in hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — long Mercury finger: mental power, grasp of languages, power of expression in speech

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Budh ungli chhoti hai — andar ke vichar bahar laane mein mehnat lagti hai: jo sochte ho, waisa keh nahi paate. Yeh capability ki kami nahi, channel ki hai — likh kar express karna, bolne se pehle points note karna, aur chhoti-chhoti speaking practice se yeh channel khulta hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — short Mercury finger: difficulty in speaking and expressing thoughts

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Budh ungli tedhi hai aur mastishk rekha irregular — parampara is combo ko soch aur communication ki uljhan ka sanket maanti hai: vichar ghoomte hain, seedhi baat tedhi nikalti hai. Iska practical tod: LIKH KAR sochna — pehle paper par saaf karo, phir bolo. Clarity practice se aati hai, aur likhna uska sabse chhota raasta hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — crooked Mercury + irregular Head line; 'evil sign of mentality' softened per safety policy to clarity-practice framing

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki ungliyaan hatheli ke anupaat mein lambi hain — Cheiro ke anusaar yeh badhi hui intellectuality aur maansik shakti ka chinh hai. Aapka dimaag detail aur nuance pakadta hai jo short-fingered log miss kar dete hain. Sochne ka kaam aapke liye bana hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — fingers long in proportion to palm: greater intellectuality and mental power (short-finger counterpart excluded, see policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro ka lean-rule: jab koi ungli apni padosi ungli ki taraf jhukti hai, toh woh us ungli ke gun apna leti hai — jaise Surya ungli Shani ki taraf jhuke toh fame-drive mein gambhirta ghul jaati hai. Reading mein har jhukaav ek flavour-mix hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — leaning fingers take the qualities of the finger toward which they lean

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro ka spacing-map — ungliyon ke beech ki khuli jagah aazadi ka naksha hai: angoothe aur pehli ungli ke beech chauda gap = ICCHHA ki aazadi aur nidarta; pehli-doosri ke beech = VICHAR ki aazadi; doosri-teesri ke beech = HALAAT se aazadi (paise-parivesh ki parwah kam); teesri-chauthi ke beech = KARM ki aazadi (apne dhang se kaam karna). Jitna khula haath, utna aazad insaan.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — finger spacing independence map (see meta.finger_spacing_map)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki ungliyaan dheeli hain aur halki peechhe ki taraf mudti hain — open-minded, naye ideas ko turant pakadne wala dimaag. Suggestion do, aap usme possibilities dekh lete ho. Trade-off: stick-at-it wali methodical pakad kam — isliye naye ideas ke saath ek finish-line system rakho, warna shuruaatein bahut, samaptiyaan kam.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — loose backward-curving fingers: open-minded quick grasp, less methodical persistence

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki ungliyaan andar ki taraf mudti hain — savdhaan, sambhal kar chalne wala swabhav: jo pata hai aur jo paas hai, usko pakad kar rakhna. Naye ideas ko waqt lagta hai, par jo apnate ho use poora nibhate ho. Duniya ko early-adopters bhi chahiye aur aap jaise quality-checkers bhi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — inward-curved fingers: cautious, slow to new ideas, holds what he has

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki ungliyon ke joints smooth hain — vichar bina ruke seedha action mein jaata hai: impulsive-intuitive processing. Speed aur spontaneity aapki taqat hai; detail-checking ke liye ek doosri aankh (checklist ya partner) rakh lo, kyunki aapka dimaag udaan ke liye bana hai, proof-reading ke liye nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — smooth-jointed fingers: more impulsive

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki ungliyon ke joints ubhre hue (knotty) hain — Cheiro ke anusaar yeh mahaan ORGANISERS ka chinh hai: joints impulse ko rok kar reflection ka samay dete hain, isliye detail, planning aur soch-samajh kar kaam karna aapka natural mode hai. Bade plans jinko baareeki chahiye — woh aap jaise haathon se hi poore hote hain.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.III — knotty joints: reflection, love of detail, hands of great organisers

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke haath mein Shukra Mekhala (Girdle of Venus) hai — aur yahan Cheiro doosre palmists se alag rai rakhte hain: yeh sthool bhog ka nahi, MANSIK teevrata ka chinh hai. Bhavnayein aap dimaag se jeete ho — prem, sensuality, sambandhon ko samajhne-padhne ka gehra intellectual aakarshan, par jeevan mein sanyam. Refined sensitivity ka mark.

sources.loc: Ch.XI — Girdle of Venus; Cheiro's contrarian mental-not-physical reading (1-1, Plate XX)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shukra Mekhala tukdon mein bani hai — mood ka utaar-chadhav aapka sabse bada pattern hai. Aaj aasman, kal zameen. Yeh sensitivity ki nishani hai, kharabi nahi — par apne mood-cycles ko track karna (aur unpe bade faisle na lena) aapke liye game-changer hoga.

sources.loc: Ch.XI — broken Girdle: hysterical temperament softened to mood-variability framing

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shukra Mekhala haath ke kinare se nikal kar vivah rekhaon ko kaat-ti hai — parampara mein iska arth: badalta mood rishton par bhaari pad sakta hai. Saathi ko aapke ups-downs samajhna mushkil lagega. Bachav ek hi hai — mood ko chhupao mat, bolo: 'aaj mera din bhaari hai' kehna aadha jhagda pehle hi khatam kar deta hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XI — Girdle passing out through Marriage lines; 'unusually unhappy marriage' softened per safety policy to actionable communication framing

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shukra Mekhala Shani se Budh tak bani hai — kalpana ki dhaara gehri hai par uska rukh andhere ki taraf jhukta hai: overthinking, dark scenarios, man hi man uljhan. Is oorja ko creative outlet chahiye — likhna, banana, express karna. Khali dimaag mein yeh dhaara ulti ghoomti hai, kaam mein lagao toh yahi depth aapki taqat hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XI — Saturn-to-Mercury Girdle; 'morbid unhealthy imaginings' softened per safety policy to creative-channeling framing

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shani parvat par Ring of Saturn hai — ek durlabh chinh jo akelepan aur zid ke pattern ka sanket deta hai: apni duniya mein rehna, salah se chidna, aur plans ko beech mein chhod dena. Parampara ise kathin maanti hai, par iska tod bhi utna hi saaf hai: (1) ek kaam poora karke hi doosra shuru karo — completion discipline, (2) do-teen bharosemand logon ko apne plans mein jodo. Akela sher bhi jhund ke bina shikar nahi kar paata.

sources.loc: Ch.XI — Ring of Saturn (2, Plate XX); doom/tragedy/fatality clauses excluded per safety policy, encoded as isolation + completion-discipline framing

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki kalai par teenon bracelets (manibandh rekhayein) hain — Greek parampara inhe Swasthya, Dhan aur Sukh ke kangan kehti thi. Cheiro khud maante hain ki teenon ek saath milna durlabh hai, kyunki jeevan mein yeh teenon cheezein ek saath kam hi milti hain. Aapke haath mein teeno ka vaada likha hai — ab kamana aapka kaam hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XI — the three Bracelets: Health, Wealth, Happiness (Greek tradition, 3-3, Plate XX)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha ke andar se shuru hoti hai — ati-samvedansheel aur jaldi excite hone wala swabhav. Chhoti baatein dil par lag jaati hain. Apni is teevra oorja ko disha dena hi aapki asli jeet hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate I position 1, pp.14-15

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shuruaat bhale hi ati-samvedansheel rahi ho, rekha aage jaakar seedhi ho jaati hai — umra ke saath aapne (ya aap) buddhi se apni bhavukta par vijay paayi hai. Yeh growth ka spashth sanket hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, p.15

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha se judi hui hai — gehri samvedansheelta aur savdhaani ka sanket. Aap apni pratibha ko kam aankte hain. Sach yeh hai ki aap jitna sochte hain usse kahin zyada capable hain.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate I position 2, p.16

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Judi hui aur halki dhalti mastishk rekha — kalakaar ka mann. Samvedansheelta aapki kamzori nahi, aapki creative shakti ka source hai. Art, design, lekhan — inme aapka sparsh alag dikhega.

sources.loc: Ch.II, p.16

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bahar se shaant, andar se chattaan — samvedansheel hote hue bhi apne usoolon ke liye ant tak ladne ki shakti. Log aapki nazaakat dekhte hain, aapki determination ka andaza nahi laga paate.

sources.loc: Ch.II, pp.16-17

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha se thodi alag shuru hoti hai — utkrisht sanket. Swatantra soch, turant nirnay aur mansik saahas aapko bheed se alag karta hai. Aap flash mein woh samajh lete hain jo doosre mehnat se seekhte hain.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate I position 3, pp.19-21

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Alag aur seedhi mastishk rekha — logon par prabhaav daalne ki asadharan kshamata. Public-facing role (leadership, media, apna venture) mein aapki pratibha sabse zyada khilti hai. Bas ek clear purpose chahiye — bina lakshya ke yeh shakti bikhar jaati hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, pp.20-21

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Rekhaon ke beech zyada doori — bejhijhak, impulsive aur suriyon mein rehne ki chaah. Himmat kamaal ki hai, lekin plans baar-baar badalna aapki pragati rok sakta hai. Ek cheez pakdo, poora karo.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate III position 4, pp.21-22

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha halki si Chandra parvat ki or dhalti hai — kalpana par aapka niyantran hai. Aap imagination ko tool ki tarah use karte hain, uske gulaam nahi bante. Creative professionals ka aadarsh sanket.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate II position 1, p.18

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Rekha gehri Chandra parvat mein utarti hai — kalpana ki duniya aap par haavi ho sakti hai. Mood ke hisaab se kaam hota hai aur mann kabhi-kabhi bhaari ho jaata hai. Routine, dhoop aur apne logon ka saath aapke liye dawa hai; mann zyada bojhal lage toh kisi apne se ya professional se baat karna samajhdari hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate II position 4, pp.18-19 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha ant mein Budh parvat ki or upar uthti hai — umra ke saath dhan kamane ki ichchha aur usko paane ka sankalp dono badhte jayenge. Business-mind aapke andar samay ke saath aur tez hoga.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate V position 4, p.28

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk aur hriday rekha ek hi rekha ban gayi hai — ateev teevrata ka sanket. Jab aap kisi lakshya ya kisi vyakti ko chunte hain, toh dil-dimaag dono ki poori shakti usme jhonk dete hain. Yeh shakti akele chalne par sabse zyada kaam karti hai; sahi partner milna aapke liye life-changing hota hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate VI, pp.29-30

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Do alag mastishk rekhayein — dohri pratibha ka durlabh sanket. Aap do bilkul alag mansik duniyaon ko ek saath safalta se chala sakte hain (jaise naukri + apna venture). Prachin granthon mein ise dhan-prapti ka yog bhi mana gaya hai — lekin yeh dhan janm se nahi, aapki buddhi se aayega.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate VII, pp.31-33

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha se ek mahin rekha upar uthti hai — jeevan ke us daur mein ek aisa practical breakthrough jo aapke poore character ko hamesha ke liye badal dega. Yeh nayi shakha samay ke saath doosri mastishk rekha jitni majboot ho sakti hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate V position 2, p.26

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha ko chhoota hua chaukor chinh (square) — raksha ka sanket. Jis daur mein yeh aata hai, wahan mushkilein aayengi lekin aap surakshit nikal jayenge. Ise prachin palmistry mein 'mark of preservation' kaha gaya hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate VII position 5, p.31

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Rekha ki shuruaat (Jupiter ke neeche) mein island — bachpan/shuruati padhai mein mann kam laga hoga, energy aur ambition der se jaagi. Lekin yeh sirf shuruaat ka daur tha; rekha aage saaf hai toh asli udaan baad mein aati hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate IV position 3, pp.24-25

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha jagah-jagah jhirri jaisi (chained) hai — mansik thakan aur focus toot-ne ka pattern. Yeh kamzori nahi, signal hai: neend, screen-time aur stress ka hisaab rakhna aapke liye doosron se zyada zaroori hai. Dimaag ko rest doge toh yahi rekha kamaal karegi.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate IV position 1, pp.22-23 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki hriday rekha gehri aur saaf hai — bhavnaon mein sthirta aur prem mein spashtata ka sanket. Jo mehsoos karte ho, poori tarah karte ho.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — Line of Heart, quality baseline (chestofbooks)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha Guru parvat ke bahari kinare se uthti hai — aap prem mein andhe bhakt hote hain. Jise chahte hain, usme koi kami nazar nahi aati, aur ideal itna ooncha rakhte hain ki nirasha ka khatra badh jaata hai. Prem karo, par aankhein khuli rakho.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — origin: extreme outside of Mount of Jupiter (2, Plate XVI)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha Guru parvat ke kendra se uthti hai — Cheiro ke anusaar iski sabse shubh sthiti. Prem mein pakke aur bharosemand, maan-maryada ka ooncha code, aur saathi ko safal dekhne ki mahatvakanksha. Ek baar dil diya toh jeevan bhar ka saath — aise log doosri shaadi ya alagav mein vishwas nahi rakhte.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — origin: centre of Mount of Jupiter

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha pehli aur doosri ungli ke beech se uthti hai — shaant lekin bahut gehra prem swabhav. Dikhawa kam, tyaag zyada: jinse prem karte hain unke liye bade se bada balidaan kar sakte hain, aur saathi se devta jaisi ummeed nahi rakhte. Vyavharik aur gehra — santulit prem ka sunhera madhya-marg.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — origin: between first and second fingers (3, Plate XVI)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha Shani parvat se uthti hai — prem mein apni zarooraton ko pehle rakhne ki pravritti. Jo chahiye use paane mein zid poori, par paane ke baad komalta kam. Saathi ki galti maaf karna mushkil, apni galti par aankh band. Yeh jaankar chalna hi rishton ko bachata hai — thodi si narmi bahut kuch badal degi.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — origin: Mount of Saturn (4, Plate XVI)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha Shani parvat ke theek neeche se uthti hai — Saturn-origin ke saare lakshan aur bhi teevra roop mein. Apni duniya mein rehne ka swabhav prabal hai; doosron ki khushi ka khayal conscious effort se hi aayega. Rishton mein jaan-boojh kar dena seekhna aapki sabse badi growth hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — origin: under base of Mount of Saturn (5, Plate XVI)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha chhoti hai — prem ke unche bhaav (romance, samarpan, bhavukta) kam ubharte hain. Vyavharik rishte aapko zyada suit karte hain, par saathi ko express karna conscious habit banana hoga.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — the shorter the Line of Heart, the less the higher sentiments manifest

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha hatheli ke ek kinare se doosre tak atyadhik lambi hai — prem mein adhikaar-bhaav aur jalan (jealousy) ki teevra pravritti. Yeh prem ki gehrai ka hi doosra roop hai, par bina lagaam ke rishton ko jala sakti hai. Trust-building par kaam karna aapke liye zaroori hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — Line of Heart in excess denotes tendency toward jealousy (2, Plate XVI)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Atyadhik lambi hriday rekha ke saath mastishk rekha Chandra parvat ki ore dhalti hai — jalan mein kalpana bhi shaamil ho jaati hai: bina baat ke scenarios banna, shak ka barhna. Iska tod hai seedhi baat-cheet — man mein kahani banane se pehle saathi se poochh lena.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — jealousy alarmingly increased when Head Line slopes to Mount of Moon (6, Plate XVI)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha Guru parvat ke paas neeche ki ore mudti hai — dil sahi jagah lagane ki pehchaan kamzor padti hai, aur prem mein nirasha ka pattern ban sakta hai. Achhi baat: aapka swabhav behad dayalu aur sneh se bhara hai, aur aap status dekh kar prem nahi karte. Bas jaldi commit mat karo — samay lo, parakh lo, phir dil do.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — curving downward at base of Mount of Jupiter (7, Plate XVI); softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha zanjeer jaisi bani hai ya chhoti-chhoti rekhaon se bhari hai — flirtation aur badalte aakarshan ka swabhav. Naye rishton ka romanch pasand hai, tikna mushkil lagta hai. Agar lambe saath ki chah hai toh novelty ko rishte ke ANDAR dhoondhna seekhna hoga, bahar nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — chained Heart Line denotes flirtations and inconstancy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shani se uthti chaudi, zanjeer jaisi hriday rekha — prem aur vipreet ling ke prati gehri udaseenta ya kadvahat ka sanket. Shayad puraane anubhavon ne bharosa toda hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai — vishwas dobara banta hai, bas dheere aur sahi logon ke saath.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — chained broad line from Saturn; source's harsher claim softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha peeli, chaudi aur uthli hai — bhavnaon mein ek 'sab dekha hai' wali udaseenta. Kisi cheez mein poora dil nahi lagta. Iska ilaaj bada prem nahi, chhoti genuine khushi hai — roz ek cheez jo sach mein achhi lage.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — pale and broad without depth denotes blase, indifferent nature

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha bahut neeche, mastishk rekha ko chhooti hui hai — dil hamesha dimaag ke faislon mein dakhal deta hai. Career, paisa, logic — sab par bhavnayein haavi ho jaati hain. Bade faislon mein 24 ghante ka rule rakho: pehle mehsoos karo, agle din decide karo.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — very low, almost touching Line of Head: heart interferes with affairs of the head

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha bahut oonchi hai aur mastishk rekha apni jagah se upar uthi hai — prem ke maamlon par dimaag ka raj chalta hai. Rishton mein bhi calculation pehle aati hai. Fayda: aap bhavnaon mein beh kar galti nahi karte. Dhyan: saathi ko kabhi-kabhi sirf dil chahiye hota hai, spreadsheet nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — line very high with Head Line abnormally high: heart ruled by head, calculating in love

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hatheli par mastishk aur hriday rekha mil kar ek hi gehri rekha ban gayi hai — atyant ekagra, all-or-nothing swabhav. Prem karo toh poore dimaag se, kaam karo toh poore dil se. Dar naam ki cheez kam mehsoos hoti hai aur zid prachand hai. Yehi shakti hai aur yehi khatra bhi — risk lene se pehle ek baar rukna aapke liye zaroori aadat hai; suraksha ko halke mein mat lo.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — single blended head+heart line (see also Plate VI); death/accident clause excluded per safety policy, softened to risk-awareness

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha ki shuruaat mein kaanta (fork) hai — ek shakha Guru parvat par, doosri pehli-doosri ungli ke beech. Cheiro ise sabse shubh sanketon mein ginte hain: santulit, khush-mizaaj aur sneh se bharpoor swabhav, aur prem ke maamlon mein bade sukh ka vaada. Rishton mein aapko ideality aur practicality dono ka best milta hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — fork at commencement, one branch on Jupiter, other between first and second fingers

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha patli hai aur usme koi shakha nahi — bhavnatmak thandak ka sanket. Andar mehsoos karte ho, par bahar tak pahunchta nahi. Rishton ko zinda rakhne ke liye express karna practice karna hoga — chhote gestures se shuru karo.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — very thin line with no branches denotes coldness and want of heart

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha spasht roop se dikhai nahi deti — bhavnatmak jud-aav aapke liye sahaj nahi hai; aakarshan sharirik star par zyada mehsoos hota hai, dil ke star par kam. Yeh koi kami nahi, ek banawat hai — par gehre rishte chahiye toh emotional connection par jaan-boojh kar mehnat karni hogi.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — no Line of Heart; source's harsher wording (with high Mount of Venus) softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha mein toot (break) hai — jeevan mein kisi gehre bhavnatmak aaghat ka sanket, jaise dil tootne ka aisa anubhav jo lambe samay tak saath rehta hai. Yeh past ki chhaap ho sakti hai, bhavishya ka faisla nahi. Aisi gehri chot ke baad healing mein samay lagta hai — apne logon ka sahara lena kamzori nahi, samajhdari hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VII — broken Heart Line; source's 'never recovered' fatalism removed per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke haath mein swasthya rekha hai hi nahi — aur Cheiro ke anusaar yeh sabse achha sanket hai! Iski anupasthiti behad majboot constitution aur swasth nervous system ki nishani maani jaati hai. Aapki body ka default mode hi 'strong' hai.

sources.loc: Ch.X — absence of Health line denotes extremely robust constitution

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Swasthya rekha seedhi neeche jaati hai aur jeevan rekha ko chhooti nahi — iska matlab: constitution bhale hi bahut heavy-duty na ho, par wiry hai. Bimari se ladne ki reserve shakti gehri hai. Aap girte kam ho, aur girke uthte jaldi ho.

sources.loc: Ch.X — straight Health line not touching Life line: wiry, great reserve resistance (3-3, Plate XIX)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro swasthya rekha ko jeevan ka 'thermometer' kehte hain — yeh badalti rehti hai. Jab yeh gehri dikhne lage toh iska paramparik arth hai ki nervous system par wear-and-tear badh raha hai, khaaskar mental overwork se. Signal saaf hai: aaram, neend aur stress-management ko abhi priority do — yeh rekha halki bhi ho jaati hai jab sharir sambhal jaata hai.

sources.loc: Ch.X — line as thermometer, deepens with nervous wear and over-taxed mental strength; fades with returning strength

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Swasthya rekha tedhi-medhi aur peelapan liye hai — parampara ise paachan aur pitt (digestion/liver ke domain) par dhyan dene ka sanket maanti hai, jiska asar mood par bhi padta hai (chidchidapan, bhaaripan). Practical roop mein: khaan-paan halka rakho, paani zyada, tel-talan kam. Koi diagnosis nahi — sirf ek nudge.

sources.loc: Ch.X — twisted, irregular, yellowish line; softened to wellness framing per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka haath Elementary type ka hai — chhota, thos, mazboot banawat. Aapki taqat simplicity aur sahansheelta hai — jo saamne hai, usse nipatna aapko aata hai.

sources.loc: Part II — Elementary hand (Fig.1, Plate I); Victorian slurs softened per policy, render weight deliberately low

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka haath Square — Useful/Practical — type ka hai: chaukor hatheli, square-cut ungliyaan. Solid, serious worker — business, law, medicine, science jaise fields mein Cheiro ke anusaar yeh type sabse zyada safal hota hai. Hawa mein mehal nahi, zameen par imarat banane wale haath.

sources.loc: Part II — Square/Useful hand (Fig.2, Plate I)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Square haath ke saath lamba, stiff-jointed angootha — determination ka double dose: jo thaan liya, woh hokar rahega. Zid bhi isi package mein aati hai. Bahas mein aapko harana lagbhag namumkin hai — bas yeh dekhna ki har ladai ladne layak ho.

sources.loc: Part II — Square hand determined/obstinate with long stiff first thumb joint

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka haath Spatulate type ka hai — ungliyon ke sire par chaude pads, thodi irregular banawat. Cheiro ke anusaar yeh 'hamesha kuch na kuch thok-peet karne walon' ka haath hai: athak oorja, zabardast originality, inventive aur unconventional soch, khuli bhavnayein. Jahan doosre rukte hain, aapka engine wahan se shuru hota hai. Builder/maker DNA.

sources.loc: Part II — Spatulate hand (Fig.3): untiring energy, originality, inventive, unconventional

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Spatulate hatheli ungliyon ki base par zyada chaudi hai — is variant mein oorja ke saath practicality aati hai: kaam aur soch mein zameen se jude, impulse par kam behne wale. Idea + execution dono ek hi haath mein.

sources.loc: Part II — Spatulate wider at finger base: more practical, less impulsive

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki Spatulate hatheli kalai ki taraf zyada chaudi hai — is variant mein impulse ka accelerator zyada tez hai: bolne, karne aur gussa hone mein jaldi. Speed aapki taqat hai, par bade faislon par 24-ghante ka pause rule laga lo — jitna tez engine, utna zaroori brake.

sources.loc: Part II — Spatulate wider at wrist: carried by impulses, hasty in temper, speech, action

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka haath Philosophic type ka hai — lamba, patla, ubhri hui joints wala. Greek parampara se hi yeh gyaan-premiyon ka haath maana gaya: gehre padhne wale, literature ki taraf khinchav, akele baith kar sochne mein sukoon, aur ek halka ascetic (tapasvi) streak. Puraane zamane ke woh monks jinhone shastra aur vigyan ke granth likhe — sabke haath aise hi the. Cheiro ise maansik vikas ke sabse unche types mein ginte hain.

sources.loc: Part II — Philosophic hand (Fig.4): studious, literary, ascetic; highest mental developments

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke haath mein aaj ke daur ka sabse kaam ka combo hai — square (practical) hatheli par philosophic (studious) ungliyaan. Matlab: practical foundation ke upar sochne-padhne wala dimaag apni theories, research aur likhai banata hai. Scholar jo bill bhi bhar sakta hai — Cheiro khud maante hain ki modern zamane mein asli philosophic haath ka yahi upgraded roop chalta hai.

sources.loc: Part II — modified philosophic: square palm + philosophic fingers, practical base for studious mind

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Philosophic haath ke saath Cheiro ki ek honest warning bhi hai: yeh type Square haathon jitna dhan shayad hi jama karta hai — kyunki priority gyaan hai, paisa nahi. Iska matlab gareebi nahi, bas yeh ki wealth aapke liye by-default nahi aayegi — usse system banana padega (auto-invest, fixed saving) taaki dimaag books mein rahe aur paisa apne aap badhta rahe.

sources.loc: Part II — philosophic type rarely accumulates wealth like the Square hand

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka haath Conic — Artistic — type ka hai: graceful banawat, taper hoti nukili ungliyaan. Iska arth kalatmak temperament: rang, sangeet, sundarta aur fine arts ke prati gehri samvedansheelta. Zaroori nahi aap painter hi ho — par sundar cheezein aapke andar kuch chhoo jaati hain jo doosron ko dikhta bhi nahi. Aesthetic sense aapka built-in gift hai.

sources.loc: Part II — Conic/Artistic hand: emotional artistic temperament, sensitive to colour, music, fine arts

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka Conic haath naram aur bhara hua hai — Cheiro ki saaf warning: is variant mein aaram-pasandi (indolence) built-in aati hai. Kala ki APPRECIATION mein samay chala jaata hai, CREATION mein nahi. Formula seedha hai: consume kam, create zyada — roz ek chhoti cheez banao, chahe adhoori ho. Talent aapke paas pehle se hai; usse output tak le jaana hi asli kaam hai.

sources.loc: Part II — soft/fleshy conic: pronounced indolence, squanders time appreciating rather than creating

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka Conic haath firm aur kasa hua hai — Cheiro ke anusaar yahi woh variant hai jo apne artistic temperament se sach mein KUCH BANA leta hai. Sensitivity + discipline ka rare combo: kala ka gift bhi hai aur usse duniya tak pahunchane ka dum bhi. Creator economy aapke liye bani hai.

sources.loc: Part II — harder/firmer conic hand: possessor really makes something of the artistic temperament

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka haath Psychic — Idealistic — type ka hai: patla, nazuk, sundar banawat. Cheiro ise shuddh maansik star par haath ka sabse uncha vikas kehte hain: sapnon, aadarshon aur antardrishti ki duniya ke log, jinke paas vision aur sookshm samajh ka durlabh gift hota hai. Is gift ki ek shart hai — practical STRUCTURE: fixed routine, paise ka automatic system, aur grounded log saath mein. Jab zameen ka intezam pakka ho, tab yeh haath aasman ki cheezein dekh pata hai — aur wahi iska asli kamaal hai.

sources.loc: Part II — Psychic/Idealistic hand; starvation and suicide clauses excluded per safety policy, encoded as support-structure framing

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka haath Mixed type ka hai — alag-alag ungliyaan alag types ki (koi pointed, koi square, koi spatulate). Iska arth: versatility aapka middle name hai — har vishay par baat kar sakte ho, har kaam thoda-bahut aata hai. Iska tax: purpose badalta rehta hai, toh ek talent gehra hone se pehle agla shuru ho jaata hai. Aapke liye sawaal talent ka nahi, CHUNAAV ka hai.

sources.loc: Part II — Mixed hand: versatility itself, changeable in purpose

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mixed haath ke saath saaf, seedhi mastishk rekha — Cheiro ke anusaar YAHI woh combination hai jisme versatility mein se EK talent nikhar kar champion banta hai. Aapke paas options bhi hain aur unme se chunne wala clear dimaag bhi. Ek chuno, do saal do, aur dekho.

sources.loc: Part II — Mixed hand + clear straight Head line: likelihood of developing one talent from versatility

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke haath mein Antargyaan Rekha (Line of Intuition) hai — Budh parvat se Chandra parvat tak ka ardh-chandrakaar chinh, jo har haath mein nahi milta. Iska arth: teevra sixth sense, pehle se aabhaas ho jaana, sapne jo sach nikalte hain, aur kabhi-kabhi aisi baatein 'bas pata hona' jinke liye koi logic nahi hota. Inspired bolne-likhne ki shakti bhi isi se aati hai. Apne gut par bharosa karna seekho — aapka gut aam logon se zyada data process karta hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XII — Line of Intuition (5, Plate XX): presentiments, inspiration, vivid true dreams, inspired speech

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Antargyaan Rekha aapke haath ke type (darshanik/kalatmak/sookshm) par mili hai — Cheiro ke anusaar yeh rekha inhi haathon par sabse zyada ghar jaisi hoti hai. Matlab aapka intuition sirf present nahi, apne natural habitat mein hai — iski accuracy aur bhi zyada maani jaati hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XII — line found chiefly on Philosophic, Conic, Psychic hands

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro ka ek interesting observation: jin logon mein yeh antargyaan shakti hoti hai, nashe (sharab aadi) se yeh turant kund ho jaati hai — unhone har case mein yeh paya. Toh agar clarity aur woh 'andar ki awaaz' chahiye, toh sar saaf rakhna hi is gift ki maintenance hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XII — gifted subjects lost powers the moment they indulged in alcohol

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke haath mein Via Lasciva ka chinh hai — Chandra parvat se juda ardh-chandrakaar. Yeh oorja apne aap mein na achhi hai na buri — bas ise discipline aur direction chahiye. Fitness, creation, business — kisi ek dhaara mein bahao toh yahi intensity aapki superpower hai; bina channel ke yeh bhatkati hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XII — Via Lasciva (6, Plate XX); death, addiction, and insanity clauses excluded per safety policy, encoded as energy-channeling framing

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha lambi, gehri aur bina rukavat ke hai — majboot jeevan-shakti, achhi rog-pratirodhak kshamata aur mazboot constitution ka sanket. Aapki energy ka tank bada hai; use sahi kaam mein lagao.

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate VIII, pp.36-38 (vitality framing per safety policy)

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate IX position 1, pp.37-39 (softened per safety policy)

sources.loc: Ch.III, pp.38-39

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate IX position 3, pp.39-41

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate IX position 2, pp.39-40 (softened per safety policy)

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate IX position 4, p.41

sources.loc: Ch.III Ascending Lines, Plate X position 1, pp.41-42

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate X position 2, p.42

sources.loc: Ch.III, p.42

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate X position 3, pp.42-43

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — lines should be clear, pink/reddish, free from breaks and irregularities

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — very pale lines: lack of force, loss of energy; softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Rekhayein bahut gehri laal hain — oorja ka overflow: josh zabardast, par gussa bhi utna hi tez. Yeh engine full throttle par hai; ise brake nahi, RACE TRACK chahiye — exercise, sports, mehnat wala kaam. Bina outlet ke yeh laal rang behas aur takraav mein nikalta hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — extremely red lines: excessive energy, rather violent disposition (softened to temper framing)

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — yellow lines: bilious/liver tendency, melancholy morose nature; softened per safety policy

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — forked lines generally good, increase the quality of the indication

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha ke ant mein fork hai — dual mentality ka chinh: dimaag ek saath do dhaaraon mein soch sakta hai. Fayda: versatility, har baat ke do pehlu dekhna. Keemat: ek cheez par lambi ekagrata mushkil. Deep-work ke liye time-block karna aapke liye optional nahi, zaroori hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — fork at end of Head line: dual mentality, less concentration (Plate XXIV)

Iska aaj se matlab: retirement sirf paise ka plan nahi, SEHAT ka plan bhi hai — abhi se strength, neend aur habits build karo taaki baad ke saal thake hue nahi, jame hue hon.

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — tasselled lines weaken indications; at end of Life line foreshadow loss of nervous energy; softened per safety policy

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — wavy lines: uncertainty, lack of decision, want of force

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki kisi rekha mein break toh hai, par ek sira doosre ke UPAR se shuru hota hai — Cheiro ke anusaar yeh 'repaired break' hai: rukavat aayi, par dhaara ne naya raasta pakad kar apna kaam jaari rakha. Jeevan mein bhi yahi pattern: jhatka lagega, par continuity nahi tootegi. Comeback aapke haath mein pehle se likha hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — broken lines destroy meaning at the break, but overlapping ends continue the quality

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki mastishk rekha ke saath ek sister line (sahayak rekha) chal rahi hai — Cheiro ke anusaar sister lines kisi bhi rekha ki shakti DOUBLE kar deti hain, aur mastishk rekha ke paas milen toh mahaan shakti aur vaade ka chinh hai. sources.loc: Ch.XVII — sister lines double the power; beside Head line give great power and promise

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Poori hatheli chhoti-chhoti rekhaon ke jaal se bhari hai — highly-strung, sochne wala dimaag: har baat par vichar, har vichar par chinta. Yeh sensitivity ki nishani hai, par mental worry aur decision-fatigue iska tax hai. Aapke liye meditation ya journaling luxury nahi, maintenance hai — dimaag ke tabs band karna seekhna hi asli upaay hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — network of small lines: highly nervous disposition, great mental worry, lack of decision

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro ka dono-haath niyam: passive haath (non-dominant) mein jo likha hai woh aapki JANMAJAT pravritti hai, aur active haath (dominant) mein jo hai woh aapne KAMAYA hai. Koi chinh phal tabhi deta hai jab active haath mein bhi ho. Dono haath ek jaise hon toh aap abhi wahi ho jo prakriti ne diya tha — develop hone ki poori gunjaish baaki hai. sources.loc: Ch.XVII — Right and Left hands doctrine; engine maps active=dominant hand (see meta.handedness_doctrine)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Kisi rekha se neeche ki ore girti (descending) rekhayein hain — parampara mein iska arth us dhaara mein shakti ka risaav: jis domain se yeh girti hain, wahan oorja leak ho rahi hai. sources.loc: Ch.XVII — descending lines mean loss of power (Plate XXIV)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Rekhayein zanjeer jaisi kadiyon mein bani hain — parampara mein iska arth: iraade ki pakad dheeli, ek lakshya par tike rehna mushkil. Zanjeer ka tod hai ek kadi ek waqt: bade goal ko chhote milestones mein todo aur sirf agli kadi par focus karo. Chain wale haath sprint mein nahi, relay mein jeette hain.

sources.loc: Ch.XVII — chained lines show lack of force or fixity of purpose

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Island ka general niyam: yeh jis bhi rekha ya parvat par bane, uske vaade ko us daur ke liye kam kar deta hai — ek temporary dip, poora shutdown nahi. Island ke aage rekha saaf ho toh samjho woh daur guzar kar phir raftar wapas aati hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XV — the Island reduces the promise of the line or mount where found

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha par island hai — parampara mein us umra-daur ko sehat ke liye 'extra dhyan wala samay' maana jaata hai: oorja kam, recovery dheemi. Practical matlab: us daur mein neend-poshan-checkup ko priority do aur body ko overload mat karo. Island ke baad rekha saaf hai toh wapas full form ka sanket bhi saath likha hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XV — island on Life line: delicacy/illness at that date (1, Plate XXII); softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hriday rekha par island hai — parampara mein iska arth bhavnatmak thakan ka ek daur: dil bhaari, rishton mein oorja kam. Us samay khud par narmi rakho. Saath hi, parampara ise dil (heart) ke domain se bhi jodti hai — toh regular health checkup waise bhi ek achhi aadat hai, chinta ki baat nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.XV — island on Heart line (3, Plate XXII); softened per safety policy, no diagnosis encoded

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha par island hai — us daur mein career/dhan mein setback aur bhavishya ko lekar chinta ka sanket. sources.loc: Ch.XV — island on Fate line (4, Plate XXII): heavy worldly loss, worry, anxiety about destiny

sources.loc: Ch.XV — island on any Mount weakens the qualities the Mount expresses

sources.loc: Ch.XV — Circle favourable only on Mount of Sun (8, Plate XXII)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya parvat ke alawa kisi aur jagah circle bana hai — parampara mein Surya ke bahar yeh chinh ashubh maana jaata hai: us jagah ki quality ek band ghere mein ghoomti hai, aage nahi badhti. Us domain mein pattern todne ke liye kuch naya try karna hi chakra ko kholta hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XV — Circle unfavourable in all other positions; Luna drowning clause excluded per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Kisi rekha par spot (bindu) hai — iska arth: us rekha ki quality ka TEMPORARY roken. Yeh full stop nahi, comma hai — us daur mein woh dhaara thodi ruk kar phir chal padti hai. Rukavat ko permanent samajh kar plan mat badlo.

sources.loc: Ch.XV — the Spot: temporary arrest of the line's qualities

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha par spot hai — parampara mein us bindu ko sehat ke achanak chhote jhatke ka daur maana jaata hai. Practical matlab: us daur mein body ke signals ignore mat karo, aaram ko kaam jitni izzat do. Spot chhota hai, aur uske aage rekha apni raftar wapas pakad leti hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XV — spot on Life line: sudden illness; softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Kisi parvat par grille (jaali) bani hai — us parvat ke domain mein rukavaton aur adchanon ka sanket: talent hai par raasta uljha hua, safalta der se ya mushkil se. Grille ka tod hai focus — us kshetra mein ek waqt mein ek hi cheez pakdo, jaali ek-ek dhaaga khulti hai, ek jhatke mein nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.XV — the Grille (10, Plate XXII): difficulties, obstacles, lack of success in the Mount's quality

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Budh parvat par saaf, gehri vivah rekha — jeevan mein ek sachcha, pakka bandhan likha hai. Prachin niyam: sirf spashth rekha hi vivah/sthayi union ko darshati hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVII pos.1

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Chhoti-halki rekhayein — gehri mohabbat ya aisa rishta jo vivah ki dehleez tak aaya par usme badla nahi. Har halki rekha ek aisi kahani hai jo adhoori rahi — yeh dil ki gehrai dikhati hai, kami nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVII pos.2

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha hriday rekha ke bilkul paas hai — jaldi vivah ka prachin sanket. Jeevan ke shuruati adhyay mein hi bandhan ka yog; exact window kundli ke dasha-vishleshan se aur pakki hogi.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — line close to Heart line = early marriage

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha kanishtika ke aadhaar ke kareeb, hriday rekha se door — union jeevan ke baad ke daur mein aayega. Der ka matlab inkaar nahi: yeh rekha kehti hai ki aapka bandhan pakne ke baad hi bandhna likha hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — position gradient between Heart line and finger base (inverse of early-marriage rule)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha seedhi, saaf aur bina toot ke — sukhi aur sthir vaivahik jeevan ka shreshth sanket. Prachin niyam: sukhi union ke liye Budh parvat ki rekhayein seedhi aur nirdosh honi chahiye — aur aapki hain.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVII pos.1

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha upar ki or mudti hai — swatantrata-priya swabhav; vivah mein vilamb ya bandhan ke prati sahaj jhijhak ka sanket. Iska matlab akela jeevan nahi — bas union tabhi hoga jab vyakti bilkul sahi ho aur aapki azaadi ka samman kare.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVII pos.4 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha se neeche girti mahin rekhayein — jeevansaathi ki sehat aur aaram ka khayal rakhna aapke rishtey ka vishesh adhyay rahega. Care-giver banna bojh nahi, aapke prem ki gehrai ka saboot hai — bas apna khayal bhi saath mein rakhna.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVII pos.5 (heavily softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha ki shuruaat mein island — vivah mein vilamb, aur shaadi ke shuruati daur mein doori ka yog (long-distance, kaam ki wajah se alagav, ya paristhitiyan). Yeh doori pyaar ki pariksha hai, uska ant nahi — jo jode is phase ko samajh kar chalte hain, unka bandhan aur gehra hota hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — island at beginning of Marriage line

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha ke beech mein island — vaivahik jeevan ke madhya varshon mein tanav ya doori ka ek daur. Yeh warning window hai, faisla nahi: jis daur ko pehchan liya jaye, us daur ko sambhala ja sakta hai. Us phase mein rishtey pe invest karna hi asli upaay hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVIII pos.3 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha ke ant mein island — baad ke varshon mein alagav ke sanket. Lekin yaad rakho: rekha tendency dikhati hai, taqdeer nahi likhti. Jinke haath mein yeh sanket hota hai aur jo samay rehte jaag jaate hain, woh is likhaavat ko badalte dekhe gaye hain.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — island toward end of Marriage line (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha ant mein do bhaagon mein bat'ti hai (fork) — jeevansaathi se doori ya alag-alag rehne ka yog (kaam, sheher, ya mann ki doori). Fork ka rukh neeche hriday rekha ki or ho toh alagav zyada aupcharik roop le sakta hai. Communication is rekha ki kaat hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVIII pos.4-5

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Fork gehra hai aur Mangal kshetra ki or utarta hai — kanooni alagav (talak) ka prachin sanket, aur agar ek rekha poori hatheli paar karti hai toh alagav mein kadvahat bhi. Yeh sabse serious warning-class sanket hai — iska matlab yeh hai ki partner chunne aur rishta nibhane, dono mein aapko doosron se zyada savdhani chahiye. Sahi partner + imandaar communication = yeh rekha kabhi activate hi nahi hoti.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVIII pos.5 + full-palm crossing line (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha kadi-jaisi, islands se bhari — rishton mein baar-baar uljhan aur kheench-taan ka pattern. Prachin salah yahan sakht hai: jaldi ya dabav mein commitment mat karna. Aapke liye sahi formula: lamba samay, poori parakh, phir faisla. Patience hi aapki kismat sudhaarta hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — chained Marriage line (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Achhi-khaasi vivah rekha beech mein tooti hai — sukhi chal rahe rishtey mein ek bada jhatka aane ka sanket (galatfehmi, teesra prabhav, ya paristhiti). Jo jode is window ko pehle se jaante hain, woh toofan mein bhi haath nahi chhodte. Forewarned is forearmed.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — break at centre of Marriage line (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha (ya uski shakha) haath ke andar jaakar Surya rekha se milti/uske saath upar chadhti hai — dhanvaan ya pratishthit vyakti se vivah ka prachin yog. Jeevansaathi ke saath samriddhi, samman aur samajik uchai — sasural paksh se saubhagya ka spashth sanket.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVIII pos.6

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha neeche mudkar Surya rekha ko KAAT-ti hai — aisa rishta jo aapki position, pratishtha ya career ko nuksan pahunchaye (status ka takrav, samaj ya pariwar ka virodh, ya galat sangat). Pyaar mein bhi hisaab rakhna: jo rishta aapko chhota kare, woh aapka rishta nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — Marriage line cutting Line of Sun

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Budh parvat ke upar se ek rekha vivah rekha mein girti hai — vivah ke raaste mein badi rukavatein (pariwar ki sehmati, paristhitiyan, ya samaj). Lekin niyam saaf hai: agar vivah rekha khud achhi hai, toh yeh sari rukavatein paar ho jayengi. Ladna padega, lekin jeet likhi hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — line from top of Mercury falling into Marriage line

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Vivah rekha ke upar, uske saath ek halki samanantar rekha — vivah ke BAAD jeevan mein kisi naye prabhav ke aane ka sanket. Yeh dost bhi ho sakta hai, mentor bhi, ya aisa aakarshan jo boundaries maange. Sanket ka kaam savdhan karna hai — rishtey ki deewarein mazboot rakhna aapke haath mein hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII — slighter line close to upper side of Marriage line

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mangal parvat se rekhayein vivah rekha ki or uthti hain — rishtey mein bahari logon ki dakhal-andazi aur jhagdon ka sanket. Jahan yeh rekhayein bhagya rekha ko kaat-ti hain, wahi umra is dakhal ki timing batati hai. Upaay purana hai: apne rishtey ki baatein sirf rishtey ke andar rakho.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVII pos.6 — interference lines from Mars, dated where they cross Destiny line

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shukra parvat ki or se rekhayein vivah rekha tak — rishtey mein pareshaniyan aayengi, lekin Mangal wali dakhal jitni teekhi nahi; yeh zyada emotional kheench-taan hai, dushmani nahi. Thoda dhairya aur saaf baat-cheet se yeh badal chhat jaate hain.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII, Plate XVII pos.7 — annoyances from Venus, less vindictive

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro ka khud ka cross-verification niyam: prabhav rekha bhagya rekha se MAJBOOTI se milti hai, aur usi daur ki saaf vivah rekha bhi maujood hai — toh vivah ki timing sabse zyada bharose se batayi ja sakti hai. Jis umra par milan hai (bhagya rekha ke scale par), wahi aapke union ka window hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII cont., Plate XVIII pos.7 — double-confirmation dating method

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Prabhav rekha Chandra parvat se aati hai — union mein romance ki chhap pakki hai. Aur sabse khoobsurat sanket: aapka saathi ghar se DOOR milega — yatra mein, doosre sheher mein, ya ghar se bahar ki duniya mein. Ghar baithe kismat nahi milegi; niklo, ghoomo — wahi kahin aapki kahani shuru hogi.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII cont. — influence from Moon: romantic union, affinity met while travelling/away from home

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aane wale prabhav (vyakti) ki rekha par island — jo vyakti aapke jeevan mein aayega, uske ateet mein uljhanein ya vivaad ho sakte hain. Faisla judge karke nahi, jaankar lena: commitment se pehle poora sach jaan lena aapka haq hai, shak nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII cont., Plate XVIII pos.8 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Union ke milan-bindu ke BAAD bhagya rekha aur majboot dikhti hai — vivah se unnati ka pakka sanket. Jeevansaathi aapke liye bhagyashali hai: union ke baad dhan, pad aur pragati badhegi. Aur agar usi daur mein Surya rekha bhi ubharti hai, toh yeh sasural/saathi se saubhagya ka sabse prabal yog hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII cont. — Fate line stronger after Influence joins; accentuated if Sun line appears

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Union ke baad bhagya rekha halki ya asthir dikhti hai — is union ne (ya yeh union) aapki pragati ko dheema kar sakta hai. Yeh saathi ke bure hone ka nahi, galat FIT ka sanket hai. Rishtey mein imandaar hisaab: kya yeh saath aapko badha raha hai ya rok raha hai? Jawab aapko pata hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII cont. — Fate line weaker after union (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Ek prabhav rekha bhagya rekha ke bilkul paas, saath-saath chalti hai — par kabhi milti nahi. Ek gehra rishta jo kisi badi rukavat ki wajah se vivah tak nahi pahunch pata. Yeh sanket dard nahi, clarity dene aaya hai: jahan milan likha nahi, wahan saal mat gawao — pehchano aur aage badho.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII cont. — parallel influence never joining = obstacle prevents marriage

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shukra parvat par jeevan rekha ke samanantar kai prabhav rekhayein — teevra bhavuk, prem-pradhan swabhav. Prem ke bina jeena aapke liye mushkil hai, aur ek saath ek se zyada aakarshan aana aapke liye swabhavik hai. Yeh dosh nahi, design hai — bas commitment aapke liye conscious choice honi chahiye, bahaav nahi. Har rekha ki lambai batati hai woh rishta kitna chalega.

sources.loc: Ch.VIII cont. — Influence Lines on Mount of Venus; many lines = cannot live without love (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha ke andar Mangal rekha maujood hai — yeh aapka reserve tank hai. Asadharan jeevan-shakti, jhatkon se ubharne ki taakat aur khatron ke beech suraksha ka prachin sanket. Sipahiyon aur risk lene walon ki hatheli ka nishan.

sources.loc: Ch.IV, Plate X position 4, pp.44-46

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha mein rukavat hai, lekin peeche Mangal rekha khadi hai — matlab jis daur mein jhatka aayega, wahin se recovery bhi hogi. Aapki bounce-back power aapki sabse badi property hai.

sources.loc: Ch.IV, p.46 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mangal rekha se ek shakha Chandra parvat ki or jaati hai — bechaini aur romanch ki teevra bhookh. Yeh bhookh sahi channel maangti hai: travel, sports, naye challenges. Bina disha ke yeh energy aadaton ke galat raaste dhoondh leti hai — apne stimulation ka source soch-samajh kar chuno.

sources.loc: Ch.IV, Plate X position 5, pp.44-45 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jupiter mount ubhra hua — aap mein lead karne, organise karne aur ek bade, saaf lakshya ko pura karne ki bhookh hai. Ambition aapka engine hai. Uske liye apologise mat karo; bas usse ek worthy goal do.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — Mount of Jupiter large: desire to dominate, rule, lead, organise, carry out a distinct object

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jupiter strong + Head line lambi aur saaf — Cheiro kehta hai isse behtar koi mount nahi hai. Aapki success kismat se nahi, character aur purpose ki taqat se aayegi. Ek bada lakshya chuno aur usse chipak jao — baaki sab follow karega.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — large Jupiter with clear long Line of Head: 'no Mount more excellent', success from sheer strength of character and purpose

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jupiter bada hai par Head line kamzor — ambition ko direction nahi mil rahi, isliye woh pride aur vanity ban jaati hai. Fix simple hai: 'main sahi hoon' bolne se pehle 'kya main sahi hoon?' poochna — roz. Yahi aapka growth hack hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — large Jupiter with poor badly-formed Line of Head: pride, excess of vanity, self-opinionated

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jupiter mount flat — lead karne ya haavi hone ki bhookh kam hai. Aap comfortable supporter, specialist ya team-player ho sakte ho — aur yeh poori tarah theek hai. Agar aage badhna hai toh ambition ko chhote, measurable goals se jaan-boojh kar practice karna padega.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — inferred inverse of the large-Jupiter reading (Cheiro gives no explicit flat reading in this chapter; derived from Ch.V quality list)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 Nov–20 Dec aur Jupiter ubhra — fearless, determined ambition. Par aap 'seedha kandhe se maarte ho': ambition itni khuli dikhti hai ki log virodh aur jealousy karne lagte hain. Thodi diplomacy se same goals, aadhe dushman.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — Jupiter Positive 21 Nov–20 Dec (minor until 28 Dec): ambitious, fearless, determined; 'hit too straight from the shoulder'

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap usool wale insaan ho — bharosa rakho toh nibhaate ho, aur jhooth bardasht nahi karte, chahe dhokhe ko expose karne mein apna hi plan kharaab ho jaaye. Yeh aaj ki duniya mein rare hai; isse apni personal brand banao — log aisi hi cheez par lamba bharosa karte hain.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — honourable, high-principled, truthful; unmask deception even at own cost; respond to trust placed in them

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Business aur organisation aapka maidan hai — aap head seat tak pahunchte ho, ya government mein zimmedari wali post. Politics nahi — Cheiro kehta hai aap party line ke aage jhuk nahi sakte. Founder, director, commissioner, COO — yeh aapke titles hain.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — enterprise in business and organisation; heads of businesses, responsible government posts; rarely politicians

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Career choice mein aap sabse independent ho — family ka peshha ya expectations aap par nahi chalte, isliye early life mein ghar walon ko tension dete ho. Agar raasta baar-baar badal rahe ho toh ghabrao mat: Cheiro kehta hai aise log tab tak badalte hain jab tak asli vocation nahi milti. Bas har switch se kuch seekh kar jao.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — most independent of all types in choosing career; should be allowed to change until true vocation found

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki kamzori: har cheez ko extreme par le jaana, poori energy jhonk dena, phir thak kar disha badal dena. Pace control karo — marathon mindset, sprint nahi. Agar Head line seedhi hai toh Cheiro kehta hai koi unchaai aapke liye door nahi; bas wahan tak pahunchne ka stamina bachao.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — inclined to go to extremes, exhaust efforts, then fly off in another direction; with straight Head line no height unreachable

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 19 Feb–20 March (Jupiter Negative) — aapki ambition dimaag ki hai, material nahi. Knowledge aapko khinchti hai: history, cultures, geography, science, nature. Cheezein aapko natural tareeke se samajh aa jaati hain. Aap lifelong learner ho — isse career asset banao.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — Jupiter Negative/mental 19 Feb–20 Mar (minor until 28 Mar): mental ambition, natural understanding, wide knowledge

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Plan aapka, credit kisi aur ka — yeh pattern aapko pehchan mein aayega. Reason: sensitivity, self-confidence ki kami, aur public ke saamne aane se jhijhak. Fix: apna kaam khud present karo, chhote stage se shuru karke — team meeting, phir client, phir bada manch. Credit maangna greed nahi, fairness hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — very sensitive, lacking self-confidence; shrink from the public; others get credit for their plans

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Is period mein bahut se writers, composers aur artists paida hote hain. Agar creative kaam aapko bulata hai, toh yeh aapka lane ho sakta hai — side project se hi sahi, aaj shuru karo. Aapki knowledge aur sensitivity creative kaam mein asset hai, liability nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — a great number of literary people, composers and artists born in this period

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jupiter Negative + clear, strong Head line = sensitivity ko will power se jeetne ki capacity. Cheiro kehta hai yahi line tay karti hai ki aapke talents bahar aayenge ya nahi — aur aapke paas hai. Ab bas consistently dikhna shuru karo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — a strong clear Line of Head gives the will power to overcome natural sensitiveness and carry out ambitions

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mood ka neeche jaana, neend ka bigadna, 'sab mujh par hi kyun' wali feeling — yeh aapke patterns ho sakte hain. Cheiro ka prescription: dhoop, khuli hawa, roz movement, aur change of scene ya travel. Climate aap par bahut asar karta hai — seelan bhari, andheri jagah se bacho. Agar low phase lamba chale toh kisi professional se baat karna samajhdaari hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VII — despondency, insomnia, feeling of martyrdom; climate has the greatest effect: bright dry atmosphere, air, exercise, change and travel — softened per safety policy (named conditions excluded)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mars mount do jagah hota hai: pehla Life line ki shuruaat ke theek neeche, angoothe ki taraf — yeh physical himmat hai; doosra Heart aur Head line ke beech, hatheli ke bahar (percussion) ki taraf — yeh mental himmat hai. Dono ko alag-alag padho, kyunki ek hi insaan mein ek strong aur doosra flat ho sakta hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — two positions of the Mount of Mars (first = physical, second = mental)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Inner Mars ubhra hua — aap born fighter ho. Control bardasht nahi, har kaam apne tareeke se, aur leadership naturally aati hai. Cheiro kehta hai average dimaag ke saath bhi aise log business ya team ke head ban jaate hain aur badi zimmedaari uthaate hain.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — First Mount of Mars large: born fighters, aspire to lead

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Career mein wahan jao jahan aap lead kar sako — apni team, apna venture, ya faisle lene wali seat. Sales, ops, founding, armed forces, sports — jahan pressure aur competition hai wahan aap khilte ho. Kisi ke neeche lambe samay tak order lena aapko ghutan dega.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — heads of business houses or organisations, large responsibilities

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Zid aur 'mera tareeka hi sahi' aapki sabse badi rukawat hai. Criticism chubhti hai, aur advice tab maangte ho jab bahut der ho chuki hoti hai. Ek rule banao: har bade faisle se pehle ek trusted insaan se 10 minute — sirf sunne ke liye, bahas ke liye nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — obstinacy of purpose, resent criticism, seldom ask advice until too late

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Gussa jaldi aata hai, phat-ta hai, aur utni hi jaldi utar jaata hai — phir pachtawa ki yeh kya keh diya. Andar se aap dil ke saaf aur generous ho. Trick: garam hote hi koi message, call ya faisla nahi — 20 minute ka rule. Jo baad mein kehna hai wahi abhi mat kaho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — hasty explosive temper, quickly over, followed by regret; good-natured and generous

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Ghar mein takraav ka reason aksar 'commander mode' hota hai — aap wahan bhi lead karna chahte ho. Cheiro kehta hai aapko zabardasti nahi, sirf pyaar, patience aur tact se handle kiya ja sakta hai — yeh apne partner ko khul kar batao, aur khud ghar ke darwaze par 'boss' utaar kar aao.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — domestic friction; can only be handled by kindness, patience, tact, affection — softened per safety policy (gender-neutral reframe)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Inner Mars strong par Head line kamzor — impulsiveness ko brake nahi mil rahi. Cheiro warn karta hai ki aise log bina soche mushkilon mein kood jaate hain aur apni leadership ka mauka gawa dete hain. Aapke liye planning system (pehle likho, phir karo) luxury nahi, zaroorat hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — impulsiveness without a good Line of Head: rush into difficulties, muddle opportunities

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Inner Mars strong + Head line clear = sanyam wala yoddha. Cheiro ke mutabik aise log life mein kisi bhi unchaai tak ja sakte hain aur doosron ke liye bada kaam karte hain. Aapka asli hathiyaar himmat nahi, self-control hai — usse roz sharpen karo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — higher Mars type practising self-restraint can rise to almost any height

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Itni energy wale body ko recovery bhi utni hi chahiye. Cheiro ki seedhi salah: doosron se zyada neend lo, roz khule mein exercise karo, aur gusse ko cool rakhne ki practice ko health plan ka hissa banao. High-octane engine ko regular service chahiye.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — advice: repose, self-control, more sleep, open-air exercise, curb pride and temper — softened per safety policy (named conditions and stimulant-inclination claim excluded)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 March–21 April (House of Mars) aur inner Mars ubhra hua — Cheiro kehta hai yeh combo Mars ki saari qualities ko double karta hai: fighter spirit, leadership, generosity, aur haan, temper bhi. Energy bahut hai; usse ek lakshya do.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI — First Mount of Mars has more importance when born 21 Mar–21 Apr (minor until 28 Apr), House of Mars Positive

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 Oct–21 Nov (House of Mars Negative) — aapki himmat dimaag mein hai, muthhi mein nahi. Scenes, jhagde, hinsa se door rehte ho, par bahas mein aakhri tak ladte ho. Shaant zid: opinion chhupa kar rakhte ho aur sahi waqt par 'mental blow' dete ho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI (cont.) — House of Mars Negative/Mental, 21 Oct–21 Nov (minor until 28 Nov): moral courage, dislike of scenes, mental fighters

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap leader se behtar organiser ho — 'brain behind the army'. Strategy, planning, logistics, finance modelling, operations — ya medicine aur science — jahan jeet dimaag se hoti hai, wahan aap chamakte ho. Front par khade hone ki zaroorat nahi; aap war room ke insaan ho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI (cont.) — better organisers than leaders; plans, tactics, strategy, supplies, financial schemes; suited to medicine or science

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap itne versatile ho ki ek career mein fit karna mushkil hai. Cheiro kehta hai aise log jis cheez ki training lete hain woh seldom karte hain, aur vocation 'billi ki nau jaanon' jitni baar badalte hain. Isse failure mat samjho — har switch ko skill-stack mein jodo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI (cont.) — versatile, difficult to place; seldom carry out what first trained for; change vocation many times

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mars Negative window + clear Head line — Cheiro ke shabdon mein 'mental endeavour ki duniya mein koi cheez nahi jisme aap safal na ho sako'. Field chunne ki tension mat lo; jo bhi chuno, usme top tak ja sakte ho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI (cont.) — with a good Line of Head, success in any mental endeavour

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap apne surroundings ke rang mein bahut jaldi rang jaate ho — acchi sangat mein apna best version ban jaate ho, galat sangat mein unse bhi aage nikal jaate ho. Isliye aapki life ka sabse bada decision career nahi, company hai. Circle ko jaan-boojh kar curate karo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI (cont.) — too adaptable to surroundings and companions — softened per safety policy (cunning/treachery/poison framing excluded)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke paas ek natural magnetism hai — log aapki baat maan lete hain aur samajh nahi paate kyun. Intuition tez, psychology aur occult mein dilchaspi. Cheiro kehta hai higher plane par yeh power doosron ke bhale mein lagti hai — healing, teaching, research. Usi taraf lagao.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI (cont.) — mysterious magnetism, natural hypnotists and thought-readers, leaning to occultism; used for good when highly developed

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Is sign ke do roop hain: bichhu jo apni hi poonch ko dank maarta hai, aur eagle jo aasman tak udta hai. Cheiro kehta hai dono possibility aap mein hai — farak sirf self-discipline aur sangat se aata hai. Har subah choice aapki hai: dank ya udaan.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI (cont.) — scorpion vs eagle symbolism of the dual nature — softened per safety policy (self-destruction framing reframed as daily choice)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jawani mein constitution halka, middle age ke baad vazan badhne ki tendency. Cheiro ki ek hi salah hai: zindagi bhar khaane mein sanyam. Portion size aur late-night khaana — bas in do cheezon ko control karo, aadha kaam ho gaya.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VI (cont.) — slight in youth, corpulency after middle life; careful abstemious diet all through life — softened per safety policy (organ-specific claims excluded)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mercury mount ubhra hua — tez dimaag, wit, hazir-jawaabi aur eloquence. Science ho ya vyapaar, aap jaldi adapt kar lete ho. Communication aapki superpower hai — sales, teaching, writing, negotiation, kahin bhi lagao.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.X — Mount of Mercury: quickness of brain, wit, thought, eloquence; adaptability in science and commerce

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mercury strong + Head line lambi aur saaf = mental aptitude ka best combo. Cheiro kehta hai yeh success ka promise badha deta hai — business, science, law, media, tech, kahin bhi. Aapke paas raw speed bhi hai aur steering bhi; ab bas destination chuno.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.X — with a long well-marked Line of Head, increases all the promise of mental aptitude and success

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mercury bada par Head line kamzor — tez dimaag ko steering nahi mil rahi: bechaini, focus ki kami, aur business mein shortcut lene ka lalach. Do rules apnao: ek waqt mein ek kaam, aur jo deal 'too clever' lage usse chhod do. Cleverness se lamba reputation chalta hai, shortcuts se nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.X — with weak, badly marked or irregular Head Line: mental excitability, nervousness, lack of concentration, trickiness in business — softened per safety policy (integrity-caution framing; 'unreliable character' label excluded)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mercury mount kabhi akela mat padho — hamesha Head line ke saath. Cheiro saaf kehta hai: acche haath par Mercury sab accha badhata hai, kamzor haath par sab kamzor. Head line hi tay karti hai ki yeh tez dimaag banega ya bikhrega.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.X — 'This Mount should always be considered with the kind of Line of Head found on the hand'

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mercury mount flat — aap hazir-jawaab nahi, soch kar bolne wale ho. Business ya networking mein thoda slow start lag sakta hai. Fix: likh kar bolna practice karo — notes, scripts, emails. Aapki depth tab dikhegi jab delivery thodi smooth ho jaaye.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.X — inferred inverse of the large-Mercury reading (Cheiro gives no explicit flat reading in this chapter; derived from Ch.V quality list)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 May–20 June (Gemini, Mercury Positive) aur Mercury ubhra — aap do logon ka package ho: ek side kuch chahti hai, doosri ulta. Intelligence unusual hai, par continuity ki kami plans ko bigaad deti hai. Ek project ko finish line tak le jaana hi aapki asli tapasya hai — shuru karna nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.X — Mercury Positive 21 May–20 Jun (until 27 Jun, fading): dual nature of the Twins; unusual intelligence; lack of continuity spoils plans

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Careers jahan quick wit aur change dono ho: acting, law/advocacy, public speaking, diplomacy, trading, startup aur business innovation, sales. Kahin bhi chamak sakte ho — Cheiro ki shart sirf itni: ek cheez par itni der tiko ki woh pak jaaye.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.X — clever actors, barristers, public speakers, diplomatists, stock brokers, company promoters, inventors of new business methods; success with will power and continuity
